name: recovery-team-availability
description: Find synthetic maintenance and quality collaborators and their shared availability without creating a meeting.
input_message: Who can join a Line 2 recovery review this afternoon?
expected_behavior: Uses workforce-coordination-iq. Searches Work IQ for maintenance and quality people at PLANT-RIVERTON, resolves exact people records, and calls work_iq_find_availability for this afternoon. Returns a concise shared-slot recommendation with person IDs and explicitly labels the data synthetic. Does not prepare or create a meeting unless asked.
